title: Most Active Customer
scenario: Find the 'customer_id' who has made the highest number of orders. Return the result as 'customer_id'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Group by customer_id, count orders, order by count descending, and limit to 1.
correctQuery: SELECT customer_id FROM delivery GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(delivery_id) DESC LIMIT 1;
